title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027 – 2028 (Research Fellowships)
provider: Swiss Confederation / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS)
application_deadline: Country-specific deadlines published August 2026; application portal opens 20 August 2026
eligibility_summary: Highly qualified early-career researchers from abroad who have completed a Master's degree (by 31 July 2027; ETH Zurich: 30 June 2027). Born after 31 December 1991. Must have a Swiss academic supervisor. Priority for those who have not previously studied or researched in Switzerland.
funding_details: CHF 2,450 per month for living expenses. Additional benefits: health insurance premium coverage for non-EU/EFTA countries, one-time CHF 600 rental deposit grant, Half-Fare Travelcard, return flight allowance for non-EU/EFTA countries. Tuition fees are NOT covered (approx. CHF 600–2,000 per semester).
duration: Maximum 12 months (minimum 6 months). Start date: 1 September 2027. No extensions possible.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027 – 2028 (PhD Scholarships)
provider: Swiss Confederation / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS)
application_deadline: Country-specific deadlines published August 2026; application portal opens 20 August 2026
eligibility_summary: Highly qualified researchers who have completed a Master's degree in any academic field. Born after 31 December 1991. Must have a Swiss academic supervisor authorised to supervise doctoral theses. Priority for those who have not previously studied or researched in Switzerland.
funding_details: CHF 2,450 per month for living expenses. Additional benefits: health insurance premium coverage for non-EU/EFTA countries, one-time CHF 600 rental deposit grant, Half-Fare Travelcard, return flight allowance for non-EU/EFTA countries. Tuition fees are NOT covered.
duration: 12 months, renewable twice for up to 36 months (subject to academic progress). Start date: 1 September 2027.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027 – 2028 (Art Scholarships)
provider: Swiss Confederation / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS)
application_deadline: Country-specific deadlines published August 2026; application portal opens 20 August 2026
eligibility_summary: Highly talented young artists who do not already hold a Master's degree. Available to applicants from a limited number of countries only. Must have admission letter or proof of application from a Swiss University of the Arts or Music. Born after 31 December 1991.
funding_details: CHF 2,450 per month for living expenses. Additional benefits: health insurance premium coverage for non-EU/EFTA countries, one-time CHF 600 rental deposit grant, Half-Fare Travelcard, return flight allowance for non-EU/EFTA countries. Tuition fees are NOT covered.
duration: 12 months, extendable up to maximum 21 months depending on the Master's programme and ECTS credits required. Start date: 1 September 2027.

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
application_deadline: November 1 – 30, 2026 (11:59 MEZ) for start in HS27
eligibility_summary: Outstanding Master's applicants (no MAS). Must have very good Bachelor's results (top 10% = grade A, self-assessed). Not already enrolled in a Master's at ETH Zurich or holding a Master's degree. Must apply within the first application window.
funding_details: CHF 12,000 per semester (from HS27 onwards: CHF 13,500 per semester) covering living and study expenses, plus full tuition fee waiver. Approximately 60 scholarships available for academic year 2027/28.
duration: Regular duration of the Master's programme (3 or 4 semesters). Tuition fee waiver covers the same period.

title: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
application_deadline: External candidates: 15 December (1st round) or 31 March (2nd round). Internal candidates (same field): 31 January (1st round) or 15 April (2nd round).
eligibility_summary: Outstanding students beginning Master's studies at EPFL. Based on academic excellence, qualifications, and motivation. Candidates who already hold a Master's degree or are currently enrolled in a Master's at EPFL are not eligible.
funding_details: CHF 10,000 per semester, with maximum coverage of 4 semesters. Additional benefit: reservation of a student room in a student residence (for external candidates only). Certificate of excellence upon completion.
duration: Two to three semesters of the Master's cycle plus one semester for the Master's project (depending on program duration).

title: EPFL Bachelor Excellence Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Holders of a Swiss high-school maturity diploma or Swiss vocational maturity diploma undertaking the CMS. Outstanding results and engagement in school and extracurricular activities.
funding_details: CHF 10,000 spread over three years. Guaranteed housing (request to be filled in the registration form). Includes the McCall MacBain Leadership Development Program.

title: SNF Postdoc.Mobility
eligibility_summary: Researchers who have completed a doctorate (PhD, MD-PhD) or medical studies. Submission up to 3 years after doctoral exam (PhD); up to 8 years after state examination for medical researchers. Swiss citizenship/permit or degree from Swiss institution required (no prior postdoctoral position abroad for non-Swiss).
funding_details: Fellowship for subsistence costs, flat-rate travel expenses, possible contribution to research and conference costs. Return grant available to finance initial period after returning to Switzerland (includes salary and social security contributions).
duration: 24 months (fellowship) + 3 to 12 months (return phase). Mobility fellowship must start no later than 12 months after ruling.

title: SNF Ambizione
eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers with a PhD (or medical studies) who wish to conduct, manage and lead an independent project at a Swiss higher education institution. Max 4 years after completing PhD. Must have Swiss nationality, hold a Swiss degree, or have carried out research in Switzerland for at least 12 months after doctorate.
funding_details: Covers grantee's salary and project funds. Maximum grant duration of four years.
duration: Maximum 4 years. Earliest project start: 1 September 2027; latest: 1 September 2028.

title: SNF Starting Grants
funding_type: Grant (salary + project funds up to CHF 1M)
eligibility_summary: Researchers with a doctorate and several years of research experience (2–8 years after PhD). Must not yet have achieved the objective of leading their own research project and team. Must have a Swiss link (Swiss nationality, Swiss degree, or at least 2 years research in Switzerland at 80% FTE).
funding_details: Up to CHF 1 million for project funding over a five-year period. Applicants can also apply for funds to cover their own salaries (assistant professor or group leader level). Extra budget earmarked for outstanding female applicants.
duration: 5 years. Earliest project start: 1 May 2027; latest: 1 May 2028.

title: UZH Student Financial Aid Office – Scholarships
eligibility_summary: First-degree programmes only. International Bachelor's students: eligible after earning 55 ECTS credits. International Master's students: eligible only if they hold a Swiss Bachelor's degree. Parents' taxable income must not exceed CHF 86,000 (net worth under CHF 300,000). All other financing sources must be exhausted.
funding_details: Means-tested scholarship amount based on financial need. Covers living and study costs not covered by parental contributions, cantonal scholarships, or other sources.
duration: Per semester or academic year, depending on financial need and progress.

title: EPFL Social Scholarship
application_deadline: Renewal: 1 May 2026; New/renewal: 15 July 2026; New/renewal: 15 September 2026 (for autumn 2026 start). New/renewal: 1 December 2026 / 15 February 2027 (for spring 2027 start).
eligibility_summary: EPFL students in difficult financial situations. Swiss/C-permit/refugee students: from 1st year propaedeutic (or CMS in exceptional cases). International students: after completing at least one year at EPFL and successful completion of first-year cycle. Last resort after cantonal scholarships and other funding sources are exhausted.
funding_details: Amount varies based on need. Awarded for 1 or 2 semesters (5 or 10 months per academic year). Extensions possible upon re-application.
duration: 5 or 10 months per academic year (1 or 2 semesters).

title: Hans Wilsdorf Foundation Scholarship (EPFL)
application_deadline: New applications: 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026. Renewals: 1 May 2026 / 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026 (for autumn 2026). New/renewal: 1 December 2026 / 15 February 2027 (for spring 2027).
eligibility_summary: International students: after successful completion of first year and at least one year at EPFL, residing in Canton of Geneva. Swiss/C-permit/refugee/Swiss secondary certificate: from CMS, residing in Canton of Geneva or applied for cantonal scholarship (SBPE). Managed under same criteria as EPFL social scholarships.
funding_details: Amount varies per academic year. Paid at the start of each semester.
duration: Per academic year (1 or 2 semesters), maximum 10 months per year of study.

title: Professor Charles Rapin Scholarships (EPFL)
provider: Professor Charles Rapin Fund (managed by EPFL)
application_deadline: New applications: 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026. Renewals: 1 May 2026 / 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026 (for autumn 2026). New/renewal: 1 December 2026 / 15 February 2027 (for spring 2027).
eligibility_summary: Master students, particularly from developing countries, who have successfully passed their first year at EPFL. Managed under same criteria as EPFL social scholarships.
funding_details: Amount varies per academic year. Paid at the start of each semester.
duration: Per academic year (1 or 2 semesters), maximum 10 months per year of study.

title: Orlando Lauti Foundation Scholarships (EPFL)
application_deadline: New applications: 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026. Renewals: 1 May 2026 / 15 July 2026 / 15 September 2026 (for autumn 2026). New/renewal: 1 December 2026 / 15 February 2027 (for spring 2027).
eligibility_summary: Bachelor and Master students in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or Master in Urban Systems at EPFL. Must have successfully completed at least one year at EPFL. Preference given to Swiss or Italian nationals.
funding_details: Amount varies per academic year. Paid at the start of each semester.
duration: Per academic year (1 or 2 semesters), maximum 10 months per year of study.

title: Charles-Edouard Guillaume Foundation Scholarship (EPFL)
eligibility_summary: EPFL students in microengineering with financial need.
funding_details: Amount varies. Social character scholarship for microengineering students.

title: UZH Hardship Loan
eligibility_summary: Enrolled at UZH in acute financial emergency without any debt. Must plausibly guarantee repayment within six months. Short-term bridge for financial gaps (e.g., waiting for cantonal scholarship).
funding_details: Maximum CHF 6,000 per application. Interest-free. Must be repaid within 6 months.

title: UZH Pecunia One-Time Loan
provider: University of Zurich (UZH) / Foundation for Student Loans
eligibility_summary: Swiss students and students with C permanent residence permits. For special one-off expenses (rental deposit, broken laptop, semester abroad, etc.). Only obtainable once during entire studies at UZH.
funding_details: Minimum CHF 1,000; maximum CHF 4,000. Interest-free while studying. Parents' financial situation not assessed. Only required document: extract from debt collection register (not older than 3 months).
duration: One-time loan; repayment after graduation (1% interest after first year post-graduation).
